expected.title: ALGORITHMIC IDENTITY
expected.prose: Your feed is primarily driven by creators you've chosen to follow — 70% of your sustained attention goes to followed accounts, putting you among the most intentional viewers on the platform. Your top creator, @a, has earned a disproportionate share of your time. TikTok's algorithm confirms your taste rather than shaping it.
expected.provenance: Derived from watch time deltas (linger count) on identified creator handles vs discovery feed.

expected.title: ATTENTION SIGNATURE
expected.prose: You are a deep watcher. 25% of your views end in extended viewing — far above typical patterns. TikTok's engagement model treats this as a strong positive signal: creators you linger on are amplified in others' feeds. Your attention is a resource the algorithm harvests aggressively.
expected.provenance: Calculated from video interaction events (skip/linger ratios) across 200 conscious views.

expected.title: DAILY RHYTHM
expected.prose: You are a night viewer — 40% of your TikTok activity occurs between 11 PM and 4 AM. Your peak engagement hour is 11 PM. Late-night usage is associated with passive consumption and higher ad susceptibility. TikTok's ad targeting systems actively exploit this window.
expected.provenance: Aggregated from hourly engagement frequency across 250 video events.

expected.title: SOCIAL GRAPH
expected.prose: You follow 120 accounts, and 70% of your sustained viewing goes to them. Your social graph is functioning as intended — you follow creators you actually watch. This is increasingly rare on TikTok, where the FYP often displaces intentional subscriptions entirely.
expected.provenance: Determined by comparing engagement metrics on followed accounts vs algorithmically-surfaced creators.

expected.title: SHARE BEHAVIOR
expected.prose: You are a Private Curator. The majority of your 12 shares go through direct message, primarily via Whatsapp. Your shares are high-signal recommendations, not reflexive reposting.
expected.provenance: Extracted from share method metadata and correlated with like volume.

expected.title: COMMENT VOICE
expected.prose: You are a Analytical Commenter. Your 8 comments average 142 characters. Your textual footprint reflects a analytical commenter mode of engagement.
expected.provenance: Analyzed from comment length and frequency relative to viewing volume.

expected.title: TRANSPARENCY GAP
expected.prose: Your ad interest profile is empty, yet behavioral analysis shows 8 inferred interest clusters. The algorithm sees far more than what it reports.
expected.provenance: Forensic gap between 'Settings Interests' and behavioral categories inferred from video metadata.

expected.title: WHERE TIKTOK FOUND YOU
expected.prose: Your login history covers 2 cities, with Denver as your home base. Even a single IP can reveal your ISP and approximate neighborhood.
expected.provenance: Geolocated from IP addresses recorded in 3 distinct login events.

expected.title: CLOSING SYNTHESIS
expected.prose: Across your usage history, you emerge as The Intentional Curator. The algorithm characterizes you through behavior rather than stated preferences. This dossier is a partial reconstruction — TikTok's actual model is orders of magnitude more granular.
expected.provenance: Cross-dimensional behavioral synthesis mapped from all forensic blocks.
